decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to utilize Underworld Breach in combination with various cards like Dream's Grip, Hidden Strings, and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to create a powerful combo that allows the player to cast multiple spells from their graveyard in a single turn. The deck also includes cards like Lotus Field and Consign to Memory to help ramp up mana quickly and control the opponent's board. Additionally, the inclusion of Wish allows the player to search for key combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck includes cards that provide early pressure, such as Bonecrusher Giant and Amped Raptor, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of Goblin Bombardment allows for additional reach and board control, while The One Ring and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury offer powerful finishers. The deck aims to establish a fast clock while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Static Prison and Arena of Glory.

This deck aims to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Cragganwick Cremator from the graveyard using cards like Goryo's Vengeance. It uses a mix of instant speed spells like Fatal Push, Lightning Bolt, and Spell Pierce to control the game while setting up the combo. The deck also includes cards like Psychic Frog and The Underworld Cookbook to fill the graveyard and enable graveyard recursion. With a focus on speed and surprise plays, this combo deck looks to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures ahead of schedule.

The deck focuses on using cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries to quickly fill up the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. It combines cards that can cycling and filter through the deck efficiently to set up for the combo, along with disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Endurance to control the game. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence after resolving Living End, while also having some utility cards like Subtlety and Hedge Maze for versatility in different matchups.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays using creatures like Amped Raptor and Ocelot Pride along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds extra consistency to the deck's mana base. Blood Moon offers disruption for opponents, while Guide of Souls and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury bring additional power to the battlefield. The deck also utilizes Static Prison for control and Goblin Bombardment for additional reach. With a focus on speed and aggression, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly.

The deck focuses on creating explosive turns by casting multiple spells in one turn to generate mana and draw cards efficiently. By using cards like Desperate Ritual, Manamorphose, and Ruby Medallion to generate mana, players can chain spells together to fuel Ral, Monsoon Mage's abilities and reach critical mass. Glimpse the Impossible and Past in Flames allow for card advantage and graveyard recursion, while Wrenn's Resolve and Reckless Impulse provide additional card selection and draw. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces necessary to win the game quickly and decisively.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly through efficient spells like Pyretic Ritual and Manamorphose, while also utilizing the Ruby Storm mechanic to reduce the cost of spells. The deck aims to storm off by casting multiple spells in a single turn, using Past in Flames to recast spells from the graveyard. Ral, Monsoon Mage provides additional card advantage and damage. Glimpse the Impossible and Wish offer card selection and help find key combo pieces. The deck aims to win the game through a combination of burn damage and overwhelming the opponent with spell casts.

The focus of this UR Control deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while advancing its own game plan by efficiently managing resources and maintaining a strong hand. The deck utilizes a variety of instant-speed spells and powerful creatures to outmaneuver and outvalue the opponent, ultimately winning through incremental advantage and timely threats. The high level of interaction and versatility of the deck make it well-suited for adapting to different matchups and strategies.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and overwhelming the opponent with fast, efficient damage. The deck includes powerful cards like Lightning Bolt, Guide of Souls, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to deal damage quickly. The inclusion of cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment adds removal options and extra reach. Additionally, the deck features Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's mana base and slow down their game plan. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through aggressive creature attacks and burn spells.

The deck aims to quickly cycle through cards to fill the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back into play. Cards like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries help cycle through the deck while also providing value when they enter the battlefield. Endurance and Subtlety can disrupt opponents' strategies while also providing creature cards in the graveyard for Living End. The deck also includes a variety of creatures with powerful abilities that can take over the game once they are brought back from the graveyard.

The key concept of this Ruby Storm deck is to quickly generate mana through cards like Pyretic Ritual and Desperate Ritual, in order to cast spells that lead to a storm count and ultimately a lethal Grapeshot. The deck also utilizes cards like Wish and Ral, Monsoon Mage to dig for combo pieces and protect key spells. By combining mana acceleration, card draw, and storm mechanics, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently and win the game through a powerful Grapeshot finish.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, then utilize cards like Living End to bring them back all at once for a powerful board presence. With a focus on cycling creatures and controlling the opponent's board, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden surge of creatures while disrupting their strategy with counter spells and removal. The combination of cycling creatures, cascade mechanics, and graveyard recursion creates a unique and unpredictable playstyle that can catch opponents off guard.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive creature plays combined with burn spells and disruptive enchantments like Blood Moon and Static Prison to control the board and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of iconic Boros creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls, as well as powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, ensures a strong and steady offensive presence. Additionally, the deck utilizes a variety of utility lands like Arid Mesa and Sacred Foundry to maintain consistency and efficiency.

The deck aims to be aggressive by constantly applying pressure with creatures like Arboreal Grazer and Malevolent Rumble, while also using spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat for removal. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble adds additional value and flexibility to the deck's game plan, making it a versatile and powerful Aggro-Loam archetype in Modern format.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and ramp up quickly, allowing for explosive plays with Primeval Titan to search for powerful lands such as Gruul Turf and Lotus Field. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to produce massive amounts of mana and overwhelm the opponent with enormous creatures and powerful land abilities. The deck also includes multiple utility lands and creatures to support the main combo strategy and provide additional options for victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of Sliver creatures and non-Sliver support cards to quickly assemble a powerful board presence. By using cards like Malevolent Rumble, Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, and Delighted Halfling, the deck aims to generate significant card advantage and overwhelm opponents with a flurry of Sliver creatures. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler provides disruption against opposing strategies, while cards like Morophon, the Boundless and The First Sliver help reduce the cost of casting multiple Sliver creatures in a single turn. Overall, the deck aims to establish a dominant board position and close out games with its powerful Sliver synergies.
